title: Unit 18 Consolidation: Rhetoric, Framing & Mass Persuasion

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can deploy case-marked cataphoric anchors (arra, abban, ahhoz, azzal + hogy) in complex sentences
I can utilize nominal-cataphoric frames (azon az állásponton van, hogy; arra a következtetésre jutott, hogy)
I can apply fronted rhetorical emphasis and deploy Unit 18 rhetoric and persuasion vocabulary
